narrative.overview: A calm dark-mode Power BI system for trustworthy portfolio risk review. Tonal layering, restrained native controls, and signal-led accent colors keep analytical decisions clear.

rules.name: The Signal-Only Accent Rule
rules.body: Accent color communicates data meaning, not decoration.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Do not add ornamental shadows, gradients, or glass effects to native report surfaces.

dos: Do use accent color consistently by analytical meaning.
Do retain native filters and cross-filter behavior when simplifying a chart.
donts: Don't reintroduce redundant donut or funnel visuals where ranked bars are clearer.
Don't use red for non-risk data.
